request.sql:
WITH ontime_traces AS (SELECT t.executeorderno,t.cust_code,
  MAX(t.lastshipmenttime) AS shipped,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(COALESCE(t.gpsisinraildate_to,t.arriveconfirm_time))=COUNT(*)
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(t.gpsisinraildate_to,t.arriveconfirm_time))=1
    THEN MAX(COALESCE(t.gpsisinraildate_to,t.arriveconfirm_time)) END AS arrived,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(t.requireddeliverytimebak)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(t.requireddeliverytime)=COUNT(*)
    AND COUNT(CAST(t.expected_deliv_time AS DATETIME))=COUNT(*)
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.requireddeliverytimebak)=1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.requireddeliverytime)=1
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.expected_deliv_time)=1
    THEN CASE WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.cust_type)) IN ('kamd','dc') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1
    THEN GREATEST(MAX(t.requireddeliverytimebak),MAX(t.requireddeliverytime),MAX(CAST(t.expected_deliv_time AS DATETIME))) + INTERVAL '18' HOUR
    ELSE GREATEST(MAX(t.requireddeliverytimebak),MAX(t.requireddeliverytime),MAX(CAST(t.expected_deliv_time AS DATETIME))) + INTERVAL '12' HOUR END END AS deadline,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(t.requireddeliverytimebak)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(t.requireddeliverytime)=COUNT(*)
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.requireddeliverytimebak)=1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.requireddeliverytime)=1
    THEN CASE WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.cust_type)) IN ('kamd','dc') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1
    THEN GREATEST(MAX(t.requireddeliverytimebak),MAX(t.requireddeliverytime)) + INTERVAL '18' HOUR
    ELSE GREATEST(MAX(t.requireddeliverytimebak),MAX(t.requireddeliverytime)) + INTERVAL '12' HOUR END END AS known_deadline,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.cust_type)) IN ('kamd','dc') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>1 THEN 1
    ELSE MAX(CASE WHEN (CASE
  WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(t.receive_wh),'') IS NULL THEN 0
  WHEN f.warehouse_classify NOT IN ('01','02') OR r.warehouse_classify NOT IN ('01','02') THEN 0
  WHEN f.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND r.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02')
    AND f.pickup_point IS NOT NULL AND r.pickup_point IS NOT NULL
    THEN CASE WHEN f.pickup_point=r.pickup_point THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ELSE NULL END) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END AS invalid_scope
  FROM agents_scm_order_trace_final_di t INNER JOIN
    (SELECT history.executeorderno,history.cust_code,MAX(history.update_time) AS updated
      FROM agents_scm_order_trace_final_di history INNER JOIN
        (SELECT DISTINCT executeorderno,cust_code FROM agents_scm_order_trace_final_di
          WHERE COALESCE(gpsisinraildate_to,arriveconfirm_time)>=:gea_p1
            AND COALESCE(gpsisinraildate_to,arriveconfirm_time)<:gea_p2) candidates
        ON candidates.executeorderno=history.executeorderno AND candidates.cust_code=history.cust_code
      GROUP BY history.executeorderno,history.cust_code) latest
    ON latest.executeorderno=t.executeorderno AND latest.cust_code=t.cust_code AND latest.updated=t.update_time
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT warehouseid,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(pickup_point),''))=1
    THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(pickup_point),'')) END AS pickup_point,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(warehouse_classify),''))=1
    THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(warehouse_classify),'')) END AS warehouse_classify
  FROM (SELECT warehouseid,pickup_point,warehouse_classify FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d
    UNION ALL SELECT warehouse_id AS warehouseid,NULL AS pickup_point,warehouse_classify FROM dim_bas_warehouse) sources
  GROUP BY warehouseid) f ON f.warehouseid=t.deliver_wh
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT warehouseid,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(pickup_point),''))=1
    THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(pickup_point),'')) END AS pickup_point,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(warehouse_classify),''))=1
    THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(warehouse_classify),'')) END AS warehouse_classify
  FROM (SELECT warehouseid,pickup_point,warehouse_classify FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d
    UNION ALL SELECT warehouse_id AS warehouseid,NULL AS pickup_point,warehouse_classify FROM dim_bas_warehouse) sources
  GROUP BY warehouseid) r ON r.warehouseid=t.receive_wh
  GROUP BY t.executeorderno,t.cust_code HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(t.is_dispatch)='否'
  OR TRIM(t.region_name) IN ('海外大区','国外大区','港澳大区')
  OR TRIM(t.is_virtual_odo) IN ('1','2')
  OR COALESCE(TRIM(t.vehicle_type),'')=''
  OR REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(t.vehicle_type_name),'(', '（'),')','）')
    IN ('铁柜40','铁柜45','无车型要求（常温）','无车型要求（速冻）','自提')
  OR TRIM(t.timeout_code) IN ('14','16','安全库存','调账订单')
  OR (CASE
  WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(t.receive_wh),'') IS NULL THEN 0
  WHEN f.warehouse_classify NOT IN ('01','02') OR r.warehouse_classify NOT IN ('01','02') THEN 0
  WHEN f.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND r.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02')
    AND f.pickup_point IS NOT NULL AND r.pickup_point IS NOT NULL
    THEN CASE WHEN f.pickup_point=r.pickup_point THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ELSE NULL END)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0),ontime_arrivals AS (SELECT t.executeorderno,t.cust_code,t.arrived AS arrival_date,
    CASE WHEN t.invalid_scope=0 AND t.arrived<t.known_deadline THEN 1
      WHEN t.deadline IS NOT NULL AND t.invalid_scope=0 THEN CASE WHEN t.arrived<t.deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS ontime,
    CASE WHEN t.invalid_scope>0 OR (t.deadline IS NULL AND (t.known_deadline IS NULL OR t.arrived>=t.known_deadline)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid
    FROM ontime_traces t WHERE t.arrived>=:gea_p1 AND t.arrived<:gea_p2),
    ontime_products AS (SELECT cust_order_no,cust_code,material_code,executeorderno,
  belong_base,detailstatus,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(product_item),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(product_item),'')) END AS product_item,
  MAX(CASE WHEN is_virtual IN (1,2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS virtual_excluded
  FROM (SELECT cust_order_no,cust_code,material_code,executeorderno,
  belong_base,detailstatus,is_stat,product_item,is_virtual FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_hourly_d
  WHERE (:gea_p900='' OR belong_base=:gea_p900)
  UNION ALL SELECT d.cust_order_no,d.cust_code,d.material_code,d.executeorderno,
    d.belong_base,d.detailstatus,d.is_stat,d.product_item,d.is_virtual FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d d LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT DISTINCT cust_code,cust_order_no,executeorderno,belong_base,1 AS header_present
   FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_hourly_d) seen ON (CASE WHEN seen.cust_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',seen.cust_code) END)=(CASE WHEN d.cust_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',d.cust_code) END) AND (CASE WHEN seen.cust_order_no IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',seen.cust_order_no) END)=(CASE WHEN d.cust_order_no IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',d.cust_order_no) END) AND (CASE WHEN seen.executeorderno IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',seen.executeorderno) END)=(CASE WHEN d.executeorderno IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',d.executeorderno) END) AND (CASE WHEN seen.belong_base IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',seen.belong_base) END)=(CASE WHEN d.belong_base IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',d.belong_base) END)
  WHERE (:gea_p900='' OR d.belong_base=:gea_p900) AND seen.header_present IS NULL) execution_rows
  WHERE executeorderno IN (SELECT executeorderno FROM ontime_arrivals) AND (:gea_p900='' OR belong_base=:gea_p900)
  GROUP BY cust_order_no,cust_code,material_code,executeorderno,belong_base,detailstatus),ontime_executions AS (
    SELECT h.executeorderno AS order_no,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT h.cust_code)=1 THEN MAX(h.cust_code) END AS customer,
      MAX(a.arrival_date) AS arrival_date,MIN(a.ontime) AS ontime,
      MAX(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(h.executeorderno),'') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(h.cust_code),'') IS NULL
        THEN 1 ELSE a.invalid END) AS invalid
      FROM ontime_products h INNER JOIN ontime_arrivals a
    ON a.executeorderno=h.executeorderno AND a.cust_code=h.cust_code
    INNER JOIN (SELECT executeorderno,cust_code FROM ontime_products GROUP BY executeorderno,cust_code
      HAVING MAX(virtual_excluded)=0) eligible ON eligible.executeorderno=h.executeorderno AND eligible.cust_code=h.cust_code
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT material_code,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_categ_name)=1 THEN MAX(product_categ_name) END AS product_categ_name
      FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d GROUP BY material_code) d ON d.material_code=h.material_code GROUP BY h.executeorderno) SELECT
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN invalid=0 AND ontime=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS numerator,
      COUNT(*) AS denominator,
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN invalid=0 AND ontime IN (0,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS known,
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN invalid<>0 OR ontime IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS pending,
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN invalid=0 AND ontime=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS late
      FROM ontime_executions

metricContract.dateBasis: 按TMS实际到货时间归属周期；优先目的地GPS围栏，其次到货确认
metricContract.grain: 执行单号去重，单位张；不按SKU、来源单或执行记录行计率
metricContract.denominator: 所选实际到货周期内符合剔除规则的全部已发货候选执行单数，包含待判定
metricContract.deadline: MAX(客户期望到货requireddeliverytimebak,开单确认到货requireddeliverytime,系统计算到货expected_deliv_time)
metricContract.lateBoundary: 到货时间>=基准交期+对应18/12小时为逾期；严格早于为准交
metricContract.unknown: 待判定保留在完整分母，暂不计分子，不视为已确认逾期；样本率不能替代主率
metricContract.missingDeadline: 系统交期缺失时，仅到货严格早于已有两交期最大值+对应时限才可确认准交，否则待判定
metricContract.scope: 复用当前看板：短驳按两端同提货点且均工厂仓/工厂外租仓；剔除海外/国外/港澳、未派车、虚拟1/2、空车型及指定车型、超时原因14/16；不加OMS新增时间、最后发货时间非空或detailstatus/is_stat条件
metricContract.baseScope: 按看板belong_base筛选；郑州庞丽娟使用郑州基地准交率

WITH ontime_traces AS (SELECT t.executeorderno,t.cust_code,

  WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(t.receive_wh),'') IS NULL THEN 0

  GROUP BY warehouseid) r ON r.warehouseid=t.receive_wh
  GROUP BY t.executeorderno,t.cust_code HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(t.is_dispatch)='否'
  OR TRIM(t.region_name) IN ('海外大区','国外大区','港澳大区')

    IN ('铁柜40','铁柜45','无车型要求（常温）','无车型要求（速冻）','自提')
  OR TRIM(t.timeout_code) IN ('14','16','安全库存','调账订单')
  OR (CASE
  WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(t.receive_wh),'') IS NULL THEN 0

  WHEN f.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND r.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02')
    AND f.pickup_point IS NOT NULL AND r.pickup_point IS NOT NULL
    THEN CASE WHEN f.pickup_point=r.pickup_point THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ELSE NULL END)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0),ontime_arrivals AS (SELECT t.executeorderno,t.cust_code,t.arrived AS arrival_date,
    CASE WHEN t.invalid_scope=0 AND t.arrived<t.known_deadline THEN 1
      WHEN t.deadline IS NOT NULL AND t.invalid_scope=0 THEN CASE WHEN t.arrived<t.deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS ontime,
    CASE WHEN t.invalid_scope>0 OR (t.deadline IS NULL AND (t.known_deadline IS NULL OR t.arrived>=t.known_deadline)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid
    FROM ontime_traces t WHERE t.arrived>=:gea_p1 AND t.arrived<:gea_p2),
    ontime_products AS (SELECT cust_order_no,cust_code,material_code,executeorderno,
  belong_base,detailstatus,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(product_item),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(product_item),'')) END AS product_item,
  MAX(CASE WHEN is_virtual IN (1,2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS virtual_excluded
  FROM (SELECT cust_order_no,cust_code,material_code,executeorderno,
  belong_base,detailstatus,is_stat,product_item,is_virtual FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_hourly_d
  WHERE (:gea_p900='' OR belong_base=:gea_p900)
  UNION ALL SELECT d.cust_order_no,d.cust_code,d.material_code,d.executeorderno,
    d.belong_base,d.detailstatus,d.is_stat,d.product_item,d.is_virtual FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d d LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT DISTINCT cust_code,cust_order_no,executeorderno,belong_base,1 AS header_present
   FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_hourly_d) seen ON (CASE WHEN seen.cust_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',seen.cust_code) END)=(CASE WHEN d.cust_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',d.cust_code) END) AND (CASE WHEN seen.cust_order_no IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',seen.cust_order_no) END)=(CASE WHEN d.cust_order_no IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',d.cust_order_no) END) AND (CASE WHEN seen.executeorderno IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',seen.executeorderno) END)=(CASE WHEN d.executeorderno IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',d.executeorderno) END) AND (CASE WHEN seen.belong_base IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',seen.belong_base) END)=(CASE WHEN d.belong_base IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',d.belong_base) END)
  WHERE (:gea_p900='' OR d.belong_base=:gea_p900) AND seen.header_present IS NULL) execution_rows
  WHERE executeorderno IN (SELECT executeorderno FROM ontime_arrivals) AND (:gea_p900='' OR belong_base=:gea_p900)
  GROUP BY cust_order_no,cust_code,material_code,executeorderno,belong_base,detailstatus),ontime_executions AS (
    SELECT h.executeorderno AS order_no,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT h.cust_code)=1 THEN MAX(h.cust_code) END AS customer,

    INNER JOIN (SELECT executeorderno,cust_code FROM ontime_products GROUP BY executeorderno,cust_code

    LEFT JOIN (SELECT material_code,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_categ_name)=1 THEN MAX(product_categ_name) END AS product_categ_name

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(invalid_change)=0 THEN SUM(change_numerator) END AS numerator,
      CASE WHEN SUM(invalid_denominator)=0 THEN SUM(change_denominator) END AS denominator,
      COUNT(*) AS records,SUM(invalid_change) AS invalid
      FROM (SELECT cust_code,cust_order_no,material_code,cust_name AS name,
    region_name AS region,province_region_name AS province,
    CASE WHEN invalid_line=0 THEN changed_quantity ELSE 0 END AS change_numerator,
    effective_qty AS change_denominator,invalid_denominator,invalid_line AS invalid_change,
    CASE WHEN invalid_line>0 THEN difference_qty ELSE 0 END AS unknown_quantity
    FROM (SELECT cust_code,cust_order_no,material_code,cust_name,region_name,province_region_name,
    requested_qty,effective_qty,
    CASE WHEN requested_qty>=0 THEN ABS(requested_qty-effective_qty) ELSE 0 END AS difference_qty,
    CASE WHEN requested_qty>=0 THEN ABS(requested_qty-effective_qty) ELSE 0 END AS changed_quantity,
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(cust_code),'') IS NULL
      OR NULLIF(TRIM(cust_order_no),'') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(material_code),'') IS NULL
      OR orderstatus IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid_denominator,
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(cust_code),'') IS NULL
      OR NULLIF(TRIM(cust_order_no),'') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(material_code),'') IS NULL
      OR orderstatus IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid_line
    FROM (SELECT s.cust_code,s.cust_order_no,s.executeorderno,s.belong_base,s.pickup_point,s.material_code,s.region_name,s.province_region_name,s.cust_name,s.header_addtime,s.shipped_at,s.orderstatus,s.detailstatus,s.is_stat,s.change_order_qty,s.dms_last_update_qty,s.need_qty_origin,s.warehouseid,s.receive_wh,s.createsource,s.is_virtual,s.timeout_code,
    s.change_order_qty AS requested_qty,
    COALESCE(s.dms_last_update_qty,s.need_qty_origin,0) AS effective_qty,
    CASE WHEN shipping.pickup_point IS NOT NULL
      AND shipping.pickup_point=receiving.pickup_point
      AND shipping.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02')
      AND receiving.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS factory_short_transfer,COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(s.warehouseid),'*'),''),execution_shipping.warehouse_id) AS resolved_warehouseid
    FROM (SELECT d.cust_code,d.cust_order_no,d.executeorderno,d.belong_base,d.pickup_point,d.material_code,d.region_name,d.province_region_name,d.cust_name,d.header_addtime,shipment.shipped_at AS shipped_at,d.orderstatus,d.detailstatus,d.is_stat,d.change_order_qty,d.dms_last_update_qty,d.need_qty_origin,d.warehouseid,d.receive_wh,d.createsource,d.is_virtual,d.timeout_code
    FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d d
    INNER JOIN (SELECT executeorderno,cust_code,MAX(lastshipmenttime) AS shipped_at
  FROM (SELECT executeorderno,cust_code,lastshipmenttime,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY executeorderno,cust_code ORDER BY update_time DESC,load_time DESC) AS version_rank
    FROM agents_scm_order_trace_final_di) latest_shipments
  WHERE version_rank=1 GROUP BY executeorderno,cust_code) shipment ON shipment.executeorderno=d.executeorderno AND shipment.cust_code=d.cust_code
    
    WHERE (:gea_p900=''
      OR (:gea_p900='郑州' AND d.pickup_point='01')
      OR (:gea_p900<>'郑州' AND d.belong_base=:gea_p900))
      AND shipment.shipped_at>=:gea_p1 AND shipment.shipped_at<:gea_p2
      AND d.createsource='20'
      AND (d.is_virtual IS NULL OR d.is_virtual NOT IN ('1','2'))
      AND (d.timeout_code IS NULL OR d.timeout_code NOT IN ('14','16'))) s
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT cust_code,executeorderno,pickup_point,receive_wh,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(warehouseid),'*'),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(warehouseid),'*'),'')) END AS warehouse_id
    FROM (SELECT d.cust_code,d.cust_order_no,d.executeorderno,d.belong_base,d.pickup_point,d.material_code,d.region_name,d.province_region_name,d.cust_name,d.header_addtime,shipment.shipped_at AS shipped_at,d.orderstatus,d.detailstatus,d.is_stat,d.change_order_qty,d.dms_last_update_qty,d.need_qty_origin,d.warehouseid,d.receive_wh,d.createsource,d.is_virtual,d.timeout_code
    FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d d
    INNER JOIN (SELECT executeorderno,cust_code,MAX(lastshipmenttime) AS shipped_at
  FROM (SELECT executeorderno,cust_code,lastshipmenttime,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY executeorderno,cust_code ORDER BY update_time DESC,load_time DESC) AS version_rank
    FROM agents_scm_order_trace_final_di) latest_shipments
  WHERE version_rank=1 GROUP BY executeorderno,cust_code) shipment ON shipment.executeorderno=d.executeorderno AND shipment.cust_code=d.cust_code
    
    WHERE (:gea_p900=''
      OR (:gea_p900='郑州' AND d.pickup_point='01')
      OR (:gea_p900<>'郑州' AND d.belong_base=:gea_p900))
      AND shipment.shipped_at>=:gea_p1 AND shipment.shipped_at<:gea_p2
      AND d.createsource='20'
      AND (d.is_virtual IS NULL OR d.is_virtual NOT IN ('1','2'))
      AND (d.timeout_code IS NULL OR d.timeout_code NOT IN ('14','16'))) execution_lines
    WHERE detailstatus=10 AND is_stat='1' AND (orderstatus<>90 OR orderstatus IS NULL)
    GROUP BY cust_code,executeorderno,pickup_point,receive_wh) execution_shipping
      ON execution_shipping.cust_code=s.cust_code AND execution_shipping.executeorderno=s.executeorderno
      AND execution_shipping.pickup_point=s.pickup_point AND execution_shipping.receive_wh=s.receive_wh
      
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT warehouseid AS warehouse_id,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(pickup_point)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT pickup_point)=1
    THEN MAX(pickup_point) END AS pickup_point,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(warehouse_classify)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT warehouse_classify)=1
    THEN MAX(warehouse_classify) END AS warehouse_classify
  FROM agents_dim_bas_warehouse_d GROUP BY warehouseid) shipping ON shipping.warehouse_id=COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(s.warehouseid),'*'),''),execution_shipping.warehouse_id)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT warehouseid AS warehouse_id,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(pickup_point)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT pickup_point)=1
    THEN MAX(pickup_point) END AS pickup_point,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(warehouse_classify)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT warehouse_classify)=1
    THEN MAX(warehouse_classify) END AS warehouse_classify
  FROM agents_dim_bas_warehouse_d GROUP BY warehouseid) receiving ON receiving.warehouse_id=s.receive_wh
    WHERE s.detailstatus=10 AND s.is_stat='1'
      AND (s.orderstatus<>90 OR s.orderstatus IS NULL)
      AND (CASE WHEN shipping.pickup_point IS NOT NULL
      AND shipping.pickup_point=receiving.pickup_point
      AND shipping.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02')
      AND receiving.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0
      AND (s.change_order_qty IS NOT NULL OR s.dms_last_update_qty IS NOT NULL
        OR s.need_qty_origin IS NOT NULL)) amendment_lines) classified_details) approved_events

request.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM (SELECT executeorderno,cust_order_no,cust_code,cust_name,material_code,header_addtime,shipped_at,pickup_point,change_order_qty,dms_last_update_qty,need_qty_origin,effective_qty,
      CASE WHEN requested_qty>=0 THEN ABS(requested_qty-effective_qty) ELSE 0 END AS changed_quantity
      FROM (SELECT s.cust_code,s.cust_order_no,s.executeorderno,s.belong_base,s.pickup_point,s.material_code,s.region_name,s.province_region_name,s.cust_name,s.header_addtime,s.shipped_at,s.orderstatus,s.detailstatus,s.is_stat,s.change_order_qty,s.dms_last_update_qty,s.need_qty_origin,s.warehouseid,s.receive_wh,s.createsource,s.is_virtual,s.timeout_code,
    s.change_order_qty AS requested_qty,
    COALESCE(s.dms_last_update_qty,s.need_qty_origin,0) AS effective_qty,
    CASE WHEN shipping.pickup_point IS NOT NULL
      AND shipping.pickup_point=receiving.pickup_point
      AND shipping.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02')
      AND receiving.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS factory_short_transfer,COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(s.warehouseid),'*'),''),execution_shipping.warehouse_id) AS resolved_warehouseid
    FROM (SELECT d.cust_code,d.cust_order_no,d.executeorderno,d.belong_base,d.pickup_point,d.material_code,d.region_name,d.province_region_name,d.cust_name,d.header_addtime,shipment.shipped_at AS shipped_at,d.orderstatus,d.detailstatus,d.is_stat,d.change_order_qty,d.dms_last_update_qty,d.need_qty_origin,d.warehouseid,d.receive_wh,d.createsource,d.is_virtual,d.timeout_code
    FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d d
    INNER JOIN (SELECT executeorderno,cust_code,MAX(lastshipmenttime) AS shipped_at
  FROM (SELECT executeorderno,cust_code,lastshipmenttime,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY executeorderno,cust_code ORDER BY update_time DESC,load_time DESC) AS version_rank
    FROM agents_scm_order_trace_final_di) latest_shipments
  WHERE version_rank=1 GROUP BY executeorderno,cust_code) shipment ON shipment.executeorderno=d.executeorderno AND shipment.cust_code=d.cust_code
    
    WHERE (:gea_p900=''
      OR (:gea_p900='郑州' AND d.pickup_point='01')
      OR (:gea_p900<>'郑州' AND d.belong_base=:gea_p900))
      AND shipment.shipped_at>=:gea_p1 AND shipment.shipped_at<:gea_p2
      AND d.createsource='20'
      AND (d.is_virtual IS NULL OR d.is_virtual NOT IN ('1','2'))
      AND (d.timeout_code IS NULL OR d.timeout_code NOT IN ('14','16'))) s
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT cust_code,executeorderno,pickup_point,receive_wh,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(warehouseid),'*'),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(warehouseid),'*'),'')) END AS warehouse_id
    FROM (SELECT d.cust_code,d.cust_order_no,d.executeorderno,d.belong_base,d.pickup_point,d.material_code,d.region_name,d.province_region_name,d.cust_name,d.header_addtime,shipment.shipped_at AS shipped_at,d.orderstatus,d.detailstatus,d.is_stat,d.change_order_qty,d.dms_last_update_qty,d.need_qty_origin,d.warehouseid,d.receive_wh,d.createsource,d.is_virtual,d.timeout_code
    FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d d
    INNER JOIN (SELECT executeorderno,cust_code,MAX(lastshipmenttime) AS shipped_at
  FROM (SELECT executeorderno,cust_code,lastshipmenttime,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY executeorderno,cust_code ORDER BY update_time DESC,load_time DESC) AS version_rank
    FROM agents_scm_order_trace_final_di) latest_shipments
  WHERE version_rank=1 GROUP BY executeorderno,cust_code) shipment ON shipment.executeorderno=d.executeorderno AND shipment.cust_code=d.cust_code
    
    WHERE (:gea_p900=''
      OR (:gea_p900='郑州' AND d.pickup_point='01')
      OR (:gea_p900<>'郑州' AND d.belong_base=:gea_p900))
      AND shipment.shipped_at>=:gea_p1 AND shipment.shipped_at<:gea_p2
      AND d.createsource='20'
      AND (d.is_virtual IS NULL OR d.is_virtual NOT IN ('1','2'))
      AND (d.timeout_code IS NULL OR d.timeout_code NOT IN ('14','16'))) execution_lines
    WHERE detailstatus=10 AND is_stat='1' AND (orderstatus<>90 OR orderstatus IS NULL)
    GROUP BY cust_code,executeorderno,pickup_point,receive_wh) execution_shipping
      ON execution_shipping.cust_code=s.cust_code AND execution_shipping.executeorderno=s.executeorderno
      AND execution_shipping.pickup_point=s.pickup_point AND execution_shipping.receive_wh=s.receive_wh
      
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT warehouseid AS warehouse_id,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(pickup_point)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT pickup_point)=1
    THEN MAX(pickup_point) END AS pickup_point,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(warehouse_classify)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT warehouse_classify)=1
    THEN MAX(warehouse_classify) END AS warehouse_classify
  FROM agents_dim_bas_warehouse_d GROUP BY warehouseid) shipping ON shipping.warehouse_id=COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(s.warehouseid),'*'),''),execution_shipping.warehouse_id)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT warehouseid AS warehouse_id,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(pickup_point)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT pickup_point)=1
    THEN MAX(pickup_point) END AS pickup_point,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(warehouse_classify)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT warehouse_classify)=1
    THEN MAX(warehouse_classify) END AS warehouse_classify
  FROM agents_dim_bas_warehouse_d GROUP BY warehouseid) receiving ON receiving.warehouse_id=s.receive_wh
    WHERE s.detailstatus=10 AND s.is_stat='1'
      AND (s.orderstatus<>90 OR s.orderstatus IS NULL)
      AND (CASE WHEN shipping.pickup_point IS NOT NULL
      AND shipping.pickup_point=receiving.pickup_point
      AND shipping.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02')
      AND receiving.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0
      AND (s.change_order_qty IS NOT NULL OR s.dms_last_update_qty IS NOT NULL
        OR s.need_qty_origin IS NOT NULL)) approved_lines) counted

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM (SELECT m.base,m.category,m.item,m.sku,MAX(m.name) AS name,
  SUM(m.demand) AS demand,
  SUM(GREATEST(m.demand-LEAST(m.sent,m.demand),0)) AS shortage,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.invalid=0 THEN m.demand ELSE 0 END) AS sample_demand,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.invalid=0 THEN GREATEST(m.demand-LEAST(m.sent,m.demand),0) ELSE 0 END) AS sample_shortage,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.invalid=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sample_records,
  COUNT(*) AS records,SUM(m.invalid) AS invalid,
  0 AS missing_ship_date,0 AS unmatched_order,0 AS missing_trace,0 AS missing_ship_time
  FROM (SELECT fromorderno,cust_code,new_material_code AS sku,
  MAX(belong_base) AS base,MAX(product_categ_name) AS category,MAX(pinxiang) AS item,
  MAX(new_material_name) AS name,MAX(need_qty_origin) AS demand,MAX(qtyshipped) AS sent,
  MIN(fromorderno_month) AS period_start,MAX(fromorderno_month) AS period_end,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND COUNT(need_qty_origin)=1 AND COUNT(qtyshipped)=1
    AND COUNT(fromorderno_month)=1 AND MAX(need_qty_origin)>=0 AND MAX(qtyshipped)>=0
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(fromorderno),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(cust_code),'') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(new_material_code),'') IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS invalid
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT source.fromorderno,source.cust_code,source.new_material_code,source.belong_base,source.product_categ_name,source.pinxiang,
    source.new_material_name,source.need_qty_origin,source.qtyshipped,source.executeorderno,source.fromorderno_month
    FROM agents_order_execute_isontime_mi source INNER JOIN (SELECT fromorderno,cust_code,new_material_code
  FROM agents_order_execute_isontime_mi
  WHERE exp_flag='否' AND (order_qty_origin>0 OR need_qty_origin>0)
    AND (:gea_p900='' OR belong_base=:gea_p900)
  GROUP BY fromorderno,cust_code,new_material_code
  HAVING MAX(fromorderno_month)>=:gea_p1 AND MIN(fromorderno_month)<:gea_p2) cohort ON CASE WHEN source.fromorderno IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',source.fromorderno) END=CASE WHEN cohort.fromorderno IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',cohort.fromorderno) END AND CASE WHEN source.cust_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',source.cust_code) END=CASE WHEN cohort.cust_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',cohort.cust_code) END AND CASE WHEN source.new_material_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',source.new_material_code) END=CASE WHEN cohort.new_material_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',cohort.new_material_code) END
    WHERE source.exp_flag='否' AND (source.order_qty_origin>0 OR source.need_qty_origin>0)
      AND (:gea_p900='' OR source.belong_base=:gea_p900)) cleaned
  GROUP BY fromorderno,cust_code,new_material_code) m
  WHERE m.period_end>=:gea_p1 AND m.period_start<:gea_p2
  GROUP BY m.base,m.category,m.item,m.sku) counted

SELECT m.base,m.category,m.item,m.sku,MAX(m.name) AS name,
  SUM(m.demand) AS demand,
  SUM(GREATEST(m.demand-LEAST(m.sent,m.demand),0)) AS shortage,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.invalid=0 THEN m.demand ELSE 0 END) AS sample_demand,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.invalid=0 THEN GREATEST(m.demand-LEAST(m.sent,m.demand),0) ELSE 0 END) AS sample_shortage,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.invalid=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sample_records,
  COUNT(*) AS records,SUM(m.invalid) AS invalid,
  0 AS missing_ship_date,0 AS unmatched_order,0 AS missing_trace,0 AS missing_ship_time
  FROM (SELECT fromorderno,cust_code,new_material_code AS sku,
  MAX(belong_base) AS base,MAX(product_categ_name) AS category,MAX(pinxiang) AS item,
  MAX(new_material_name) AS name,MAX(need_qty_origin) AS demand,MAX(qtyshipped) AS sent,
  MIN(fromorderno_month) AS period_start,MAX(fromorderno_month) AS period_end,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND COUNT(need_qty_origin)=1 AND COUNT(qtyshipped)=1
    AND COUNT(fromorderno_month)=1 AND MAX(need_qty_origin)>=0 AND MAX(qtyshipped)>=0
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(fromorderno),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(cust_code),'') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(new_material_code),'') IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS invalid
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT source.fromorderno,source.cust_code,source.new_material_code,source.belong_base,source.product_categ_name,source.pinxiang,
    source.new_material_name,source.need_qty_origin,source.qtyshipped,source.executeorderno,source.fromorderno_month
    FROM agents_order_execute_isontime_mi source INNER JOIN (SELECT fromorderno,cust_code,new_material_code
  FROM agents_order_execute_isontime_mi
  WHERE exp_flag='否' AND (order_qty_origin>0 OR need_qty_origin>0)
    AND (:gea_p900='' OR belong_base=:gea_p900)
  GROUP BY fromorderno,cust_code,new_material_code
  HAVING MAX(fromorderno_month)>=:gea_p1 AND MIN(fromorderno_month)<:gea_p2) cohort ON CASE WHEN source.fromorderno IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',source.fromorderno) END=CASE WHEN cohort.fromorderno IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',cohort.fromorderno) END AND CASE WHEN source.cust_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',source.cust_code) END=CASE WHEN cohort.cust_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',cohort.cust_code) END AND CASE WHEN source.new_material_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',source.new_material_code) END=CASE WHEN cohort.new_material_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',cohort.new_material_code) END
    WHERE source.exp_flag='否' AND (source.order_qty_origin>0 OR source.need_qty_origin>0)
      AND (:gea_p900='' OR source.belong_base=:gea_p900)) cleaned
  GROUP BY fromorderno,cust_code,new_material_code) m
  WHERE m.period_end>=:gea_p1 AND m.period_start<:gea_p2
  GROUP BY m.base,m.category,m.item,m.sku ORDER BY base,category,item,sku LIMIT :gea_p1001 OFFSET :gea_p1002

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM (WITH ontime_traces AS (SELECT t.executeorderno,t.cust_code,
  MAX(t.lastshipmenttime) AS shipped,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(COALESCE(t.gpsisinraildate_to,t.arriveconfirm_time))=COUNT(*)
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(t.gpsisinraildate_to,t.arriveconfirm_time))=1
    THEN MAX(COALESCE(t.gpsisinraildate_to,t.arriveconfirm_time)) END AS arrived,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(t.requireddeliverytimebak)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(t.requireddeliverytime)=COUNT(*)
    AND COUNT(CAST(t.expected_deliv_time AS DATETIME))=COUNT(*)
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.requireddeliverytimebak)=1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.requireddeliverytime)=1
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.expected_deliv_time)=1
    THEN CASE WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.cust_type)) IN ('kamd','dc') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1
    THEN GREATEST(MAX(t.requireddeliverytimebak),MAX(t.requireddeliverytime),MAX(CAST(t.expected_deliv_time AS DATETIME))) + INTERVAL '18' HOUR
    ELSE GREATEST(MAX(t.requireddeliverytimebak),MAX(t.requireddeliverytime),MAX(CAST(t.expected_deliv_time AS DATETIME))) + INTERVAL '12' HOUR END END AS deadline,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(t.requireddeliverytimebak)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(t.requireddeliverytime)=COUNT(*)
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.requireddeliverytimebak)=1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.requireddeliverytime)=1
    THEN CASE WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.cust_type)) IN ('kamd','dc') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM (WITH stock_plans AS (SELECT belong_base,material_code,MAX(product_item) AS item,MAX(material_name) AS name,

        MAX(CASE WHEN plan_policy.initial_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.initial_day=CAST(plan_policy.initial_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.corrected_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.corrected_day=CAST(plan_policy.corrected_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.rolling_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.rolling_day=CAST(plan_policy.rolling_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.initial_day<plan_policy.corrected_day AND plan_policy.corrected_day<plan_policy.rolling_day THEN CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.initial_day THEN 0
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.corrected_day THEN 0
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.rolling_day THEN 1 ELSE 1 END END) AS plan_month_offset,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN plan_policy.initial_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.initial_day=CAST(plan_policy.initial_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.corrected_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.corrected_day=CAST(plan_policy.corrected_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.rolling_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.rolling_day=CAST(plan_policy.rolling_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.initial_day<plan_policy.corrected_day AND plan_policy.corrected_day<plan_policy.rolling_day THEN CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.initial_day THEN main_sales_plan_v1
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.corrected_day THEN main_sales_plan_adj
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.rolling_day THEN roll_sales_plan ELSE next_month_sales_plan END END) IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN plan_policy.initial_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.initial_day=CAST(plan_policy.initial_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.corrected_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.corrected_day=CAST(plan_policy.corrected_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.rolling_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.rolling_day=CAST(plan_policy.rolling_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.initial_day<plan_policy.corrected_day AND plan_policy.corrected_day<plan_policy.rolling_day THEN CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.initial_day THEN main_sales_plan_v1
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.corrected_day THEN main_sales_plan_adj
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.rolling_day THEN roll_sales_plan ELSE next_month_sales_plan END END)<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sales_invalid,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN plan_policy.initial_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.initial_day=CAST(plan_policy.initial_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.corrected_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.corrected_day=CAST(plan_policy.corrected_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.rolling_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.rolling_day=CAST(plan_policy.rolling_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.initial_day<plan_policy.corrected_day AND plan_policy.corrected_day<plan_policy.rolling_day THEN CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.initial_day THEN transfer_out_plan_v1
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.corrected_day THEN transfer_out_plan_adj
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.rolling_day THEN transfer_out_plan_roll ELSE next_month_out_plan END END) IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN plan_policy.initial_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.initial_day=CAST(plan_policy.initial_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.corrected_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.corrected_day=CAST(plan_policy.corrected_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.rolling_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.rolling_day=CAST(plan_policy.rolling_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.initial_day<plan_policy.corrected_day AND plan_policy.corrected_day<plan_policy.rolling_day THEN CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.initial_day THEN transfer_out_plan_v1
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.corrected_day THEN transfer_out_plan_adj
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.rolling_day THEN transfer_out_plan_roll ELSE next_month_out_plan END END)<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS transfer_invalid,
        SUM(CASE WHEN plan_policy.initial_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.initial_day=CAST(plan_policy.initial_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.corrected_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.corrected_day=CAST(plan_policy.corrected_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.rolling_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.rolling_day=CAST(plan_policy.rolling_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.initial_day<plan_policy.corrected_day AND plan_policy.corrected_day<plan_policy.rolling_day THEN CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.initial_day THEN main_sales_plan_v1
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.corrected_day THEN main_sales_plan_adj
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.rolling_day THEN roll_sales_plan ELSE next_month_sales_plan END END) AS sales_plan,
        SUM(CASE WHEN plan_policy.initial_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.initial_day=CAST(plan_policy.initial_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.corrected_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.corrected_day=CAST(plan_policy.corrected_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.rolling_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND plan_policy.rolling_day=CAST(plan_policy.rolling_day AS INTEGER) AND plan_policy.initial_day<plan_policy.corrected_day AND plan_policy.corrected_day<plan_policy.rolling_day THEN CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.initial_day THEN transfer_out_plan_v1
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.corrected_day THEN transfer_out_plan_adj
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=plan_policy.rolling_day THEN transfer_out_plan_roll ELSE next_month_out_plan END END) AS transfer_plan
        FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d CROSS JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(initial_day) END AS initial_day,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(corrected_day) END AS corrected_day,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(rolling_day) END AS rolling_day
    FROM (SELECT
      CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN series='<=初版' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1
        THEN MAX(CASE WHEN series='<=初版' THEN series_sort END) END AS initial_day,
      CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN series='<=纠偏' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1
        THEN MAX(CASE WHEN series='<=纠偏' THEN series_sort END) END AS corrected_day,
      CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN series='<=滚动' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1
        THEN MAX(CASE WHEN series='<=滚动' THEN series_sort END) END AS rolling_day
      FROM agents_dim_mark_xilie_d WHERE product_item='节点') policy_records) plan_policy
        WHERE the_date=(SELECT MAX(the_date) FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d WHERE the_date>=:gea_p1 AND the_date<:gea_p2)
        GROUP BY belong_base,material_code), stock_batches AS (SELECT belong_base,material_code,MAX(material_name) AS name,NULL AS item,
        CONCAT(SUBSTRING(MAX(month_date),1,4),'-',SUBSTRING(MAX(month_date),5,2),'-',SUBSTRING(MAX(month_date),7,2)) AS stock_date,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(available_qty) END AS available,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(live_qty) END AS inventory,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(aged_qty) END AS aged,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*)<>1 OR COUNT(live_qty)<>COUNT(*) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid
        FROM (SELECT belong_base,material_code,material_name,
          REPLACE(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),'-','') AS month_date,
          available_stock AS available_qty,current_stock AS live_qty,current_stock_60 AS aged_qty
          FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d) production_sales
        WHERE month_date=REPLACE(CAST((SELECT MAX(the_date) FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d WHERE the_date>=:gea_p1 AND the_date<:gea_p2) AS CHAR),'-','')
        GROUP BY belong_base,material_code),
      stock_dictionary AS (SELECT material_code AS sku,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_categ_name)=1 THEN MAX(product_categ_name) END AS category,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT material_group_name)=1 THEN MAX(material_group_name) END AS item
  FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d GROUP BY material_code) SELECT COALESCE(s.belong_base,b.belong_base) AS base,COALESCE(s.material_code,b.material_code) AS sku,
      d.category,COALESCE(s.item,b.item) AS item,COALESCE(s.name,b.name) AS name,
      COALESCE(b.stock_date,s.stock_date) AS stock_date,s.plan_month_offset,s.source_rows,b.available,b.inventory,b.aged,s.sales_plan,s.transfer_plan,
      NULL AS daily_demand,
      b.inventory AS national_inventory,s.sales_plan AS national_sales_plan,
      CASE WHEN b.stock_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS national_stock_records,
      CASE WHEN s.source_rows IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS national_plan_records,
      COALESCE(b.invalid,0) AS national_stock_invalid,
      CASE WHEN s.source_rows>1 THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(s.sales_invalid,0) END AS national_plan_invalid,
      s.transfer_plan AS base_transfer_plan,
      CASE WHEN s.source_rows>1 THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(s.sales_invalid,0)+COALESCE(s.transfer_invalid,0) END AS base_plan_invalid,
      CASE WHEN b.inventory IS NULL OR b.invalid>0 OR s.source_rows IS NULL OR s.sales_invalid>0 OR s.transfer_invalid>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid
 FROM stock_plans s LEFT JOIN stock_batches b ON (b.belong_base=s.belong_base OR (b.belong_base IS NULL AND s.belong_base IS NULL)) AND b.material_code=s.material_code

    THEN GREATEST(MAX(t.requireddeliverytimebak),MAX(t.requireddeliverytime)) + INTERVAL '18' HOUR
    ELSE GREATEST(MAX(t.requireddeliverytimebak),MAX(t.requireddeliverytime)) + INTERVAL '12' HOUR END END AS known_deadline,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.cust_type)) IN ('kamd','dc') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>1 THEN 1
    ELSE MAX(CASE WHEN (CASE
  WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(t.receive_wh),'') IS NULL THEN 0
  WHEN f.warehouse_classify NOT IN ('01','02') OR r.warehouse_classify NOT IN ('01','02') THEN 0
  WHEN f.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND r.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02')

),snapshot_windows AS (SELECT DISTINCT age_day,mapping_start,mapping_end FROM report_windows WHERE enabled=TRUE AND age_day IS NOT NULL) ,packet_source AS (SELECT q.period_index,q.base AS base,NULL AS sku,q.category AS category,CASE WHEN own.items=1 THEN own.item WHEN own.items>1 THEN NULL WHEN shared.names=1 THEN shared.item ELSE NULL END AS item,MAX(q.snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date,SUM(COALESCE(q.stock_qty,0)) AS stock_qty,SUM(COALESCE(q.aged_qty,0)) AS aged_qty,SUM(COALESCE(q.records,0)) AS records,SUM(COALESCE(q.excluded,0)) AS excluded,SUM(COALESCE(q.invalid,0)) AS invalid,SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(q.stock_qty,0)<>0 OR COALESCE(q.invalid,0)<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_records,CASE WHEN own.names=1 THEN own.director ELSE NULL END AS director,CASE WHEN own.names=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS names,1 AS summary FROM (SELECT rw.period_index,snapshot.base,snapshot.sku,snapshot.category,snapshot.item,snapshot.snapshot_date,snapshot.stock_qty,snapshot.aged_qty,snapshot.records,snapshot.excluded,snapshot.invalid FROM (SELECT b.dt AS batch_date,CASE WHEN TRIM(b.belong_base) IN ('成都分仓','上海分仓') THEN '西南' ELSE b.belong_base END AS base,b.material_code AS sku,MAX(d.category) AS category,

      GROUP BY b.dt,CASE WHEN TRIM(b.belong_base) IN ('成都分仓','上海分仓') THEN '西南' ELSE b.belong_base END,b.material_code) snapshot

  WHERE m.period_end>=:gea_p1 AND m.period_start<:gea_p2
  GROUP BY m.base,m.category,m.item,m.sku) ko UNION ALL SELECT base,sku,category FROM (WITH stock_plans AS (SELECT belong_base,material_code,MAX(product_item) AS item,MAX(material_name) AS name,
